name: Zap Dialogue NPC screen translation
coverage: The original Zap Dialogue Client 1.6.10 NPC speaker name is translated only at drawSpeakerName, never the NPC metadata, player name or packets.
Dialogue sentences and choice labels are translated at StyledText wrap, trim and length BEFORE native measurement, wrapping and typewriter truncation.
OptionScreen keeps the unmodified original option list and sends the same original selection index. Unknown multi-word text may be captured to a local bounded file only.
No custom Fabric mod, native mod rewrite, UI file replacement or network interception. Unsupported sources remain in the original language.
